description: Shows the Show's full-screen plane poster for 20 s (input_boolean.plane_takeover, the flight in input_text.plane_takeover_id) and notes the flight's kind in todo.plane_posters_today. Automation planes_overhead_takeover picks the planes; this keeps posters at least 5 minutes apart, and in single mode a call that comes while a poster shows is dropped (so that kind can still get one later). 2026-11-04. Source: ha-dashboard/ha-scripts/plane_poster.json

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Airline and type, e.g. UAL-B738 (PVT-<type> for private aircraft).

if.value_template: {{ (kind | default('')) != '' and kind not in (seen['todo.plane_posters_today']['items'] | map(attribute='summary') | list) }}
